subject: general
question: In what time will ₹3,720 amount to ₹5,282.4 at 12% simple interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

The principle = Rs. 3720

The amount = Rs. 5282.4

The rate of interest = 12%

**Formula used:**

{S.I.}={P × R × Tover100} Where S.I. = Simple interest, P = Principle, R = Rate, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the time is T years.

According to the question

Simple interest = 5282.4 - 3720 = 1562.4

⇒ 1562.4={3720 × 12 × Tover100}

⇒ 156240 = 44640 × T

⇒ T = {156240over44640}= 3.5 years

**∴ The required result will be 3(1)/(2) years.**
